meta.name: generate-taxonomy
meta.description: Develop hierarchical classification systems. Creates parent-child categorical structures for content organization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为内容创建层级分类体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为大量内容设计分类结构
copy.tagline_en: Create hierarchical classification systems for content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design classification structures for large content sets

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你指定的内容路径，提取关键主题和标签，然后生成一个包含父级和子级类别的层次分类系统。如果有需要，还可以创建多维度分类（分面分类）并输出分类树、规则和验证计划。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 对某个知识库或内容文件夹生成分类结构，例如“给 /knowledge-base 做个分类”时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 /knowledge-base 并生成一个层次分类。
say.note: Claude 会提取主题并输出分类树。

say.text: 给 /content 做一个分面分类，包含主题和受众两个维度。
say.note: 开启 FACETED 参数，生成多维度分类。

say.text: 对 /docs 生成分类，并加入用户测试方法。
say.note: 启用 USER_TESTING，输出验证计划。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes the specified content path, extracts key topics and tags, and generates a hierarchical classification system with parent-child categories. Optionally, it can create faceted classification (multiple dimensions) and output taxonomy tree, rules, and validation plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate a classification structure for a content path, e.g., 'Create a taxonomy for /knowledge-base'.

say_en.text: Analyze /knowledge-base and generate a hierarchical taxonomy.
say_en.note: Claude will extract topics and output a taxonomy tree.

say_en.text: Create a faceted taxonomy for /content with topic and audience dimensions.
Generate a taxonomy for /docs including user testing methods.
